scripts.//: The <code-preview> element behind the live demos. The `-hljs` entry, not the default one: poops highlights fences at build time, so a docs page ships no runtime highlight.js for the element to borrow, and editing a sample would stop recolouring. Linked by script/gen-demos.mjs into the pages that have a demo.
